action: Place probe in the sub-xiphoid position. Perform a complete sweep laterally all the way through the left lobe.
interpretation: Initiate the exam with the left lobe of the liver. Ensure the sweep covers the entire extent of the anatomy.

action: Reverse the direction of the sweep to return medially.
interpretation: Return to the area of interest for image capture.

action: Freeze and capture the first image at the lateral aspect.

interpretation: Identify the aorta entering the field of view as the scan plane moves medially.
Document the medial aspect of the left lobe containing the aorta.
Visualize the IVC and the caudate lobe appearing in the view.

action: Activate Color Doppler and place the box over the IVC.
interpretation: Verify that the IVC fills completely with color to rule out thrombosis.

action: Capture the final image in this sequence.
interpretation: Document the sagittal left lobe, concluding the left lobe protocol.

action: Reposition the probe to target the right lobe of the liver.
interpretation: Transition from the left lobe to the right lobe.

action: Slide the probe inferiorly following the rib line. Rotate the probe to a slightly oblique orientation.
interpretation: Align the probe technically by following the rib anatomy.

action: Apply pressure pushing in and angle the probe upwards underneath the rib.
interpretation: Utilize the subcostal window to visualize the superior portions of the liver.

action: Position the probe to view the dome of the right lobe. Prepare to take sequential images while scanning inferiorly.
interpretation: Locate the dome of the right lobe as the starting point.

action: Capture the first image of the right lobe.
interpretation: Visualize just the parenchyma of the liver dome.

action: Maintain position at the superior aspect of the liver.
interpretation: Confirm the view is above all hepatic and portal veins.
Visualize the hepatic veins entering the field of view.

action: Assess the echogenicity of the vessel walls.
interpretation: Identify hepatic veins by noting their walls are less echogenic than portal veins.

action: Trace the vessels to their termination.
interpretation: Confirm anatomy by observing the veins flowing directly into the IVC.

action: Capture the second image of the right lobe sequence.
interpretation: Document the right lobe at the level of the hepatic veins.
